name: cmux-team-dispatch-task
description: Parallel task dispatch via cmux workspaces. Each task gets an isolated git worktree and configurable agent session, orchestrated by the parent session.

interface.shortDescription: Dispatch parallel tasks into cmux workspaces.
interface.longDescription: Dispatch parallel tasks into isolated cmux workspaces with configurable planning, review, and execution runners.
defaultPrompt: Use $cmux-team-dispatch-task:cmux-team-dispatch-task to dispatch these tasks in parallel.
